integrity: The reduction from arbitrary measurable subsets to centered disk intersections is proved by an epsilon-enclosing-disk argument and planar Brunn-Minkowski. The remaining scalar objective is minimized exactly, with a unique critical radius determined by the fixed point alpha=cos(alpha). A standalone numerical checker is included only as an independent replay aid.
scientific_limitations: The theorem solves the circumradius-over-area subset problem only for a square. It does not classify rectangles, general centrally symmetric convex domains, or the analogous minimal-width and inradius variants.
title: Circumradius–area Cheeger problem for the square
